summary.name: Keynote
summary.one_liner: Apple's presentation app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and the web, for designing, animating, presenting, and collaborating on slideshows.
use_cases: Build slide decks for meetings or talks
Collaborate on a presentation with others in real time
Convert or edit PowerPoint files on Apple devices
Add cinematic animations and transitions to slides
Rehearse a talk with a presenter display
summary.what_it_does: Keynote lets users create presentations from Apple-designed themes and add text, images, charts, shapes, audio, video, and image galleries. It includes slide transitions, animation builds, Magic Move, and on-canvas animation previews. Presenters can rehearse with a customizable presenter display, control slideshows from iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch, and use multi-presenter slideshows. Files can be shared through iCloud or Box with real-time collaboration, and exported to PowerPoint, PDF, HTML, movies, and image files. The page also lists Apple Intelligence features such as Writing Tools and Image Playground, some of which require an Apple Intelligence-capable device.
notable: Free app with in-app purchases for Apple Intelligence features and subscriptions
Import and edit Microsoft PowerPoint files and export back to PowerPoint
Real-time multi-user collaboration via iCloud or Box
Works from iCloud.com on a PC
caveats: Intelligence features need an Apple Intelligence-capable device and have usage limits
Some Apple Creator Studio features require a subscription; creating, viewing, editing, and collaborating in Keynote does not
Requires recent OS versions (iOS 26, macOS 26, and others)
